_doc: Stable content dates used by src/build.py for sitemap.xml and sitemap-images.xml. These are source-data dates, not build dates: a rebuild without a source change must not move <lastmod>. Product dates are recorded only when the repository has a reliable publication/capture date. Products without one use the documented fallback. Add or update an entry when a source record's meaningful content date is verified; do not set entries to the day of an unrelated rebuild.
fallback_reason: The older Viralstyle crawl has no per-campaign created/updated timestamp. This conservative, repository-stable baseline is used instead of claiming that those pages changed on every build.
